name: ontology-navigator
description: An ontology design and adoption expert that helps enterprises build semantic-layer business ontologies and drive successful rollout, drawing on Palantir Foundry best practices.

displayDescription.en: Helps enterprises design, model and roll out business ontologies that actually get adopted, drawing on Palantir Foundry Ontology best practices.
displayDescription.zh: 借鉴Palantir方法论，帮企业设计业务本体与语义层，推动采纳落地，让数据驱动业务决策与AI应用。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我们是一家有 3 座工厂的工业设备制造商，想用一套业务本体打通销售、交付与售后数据，让管理层实时掌握交付与质量状况。请直接给出：锚定场景建议、对象/链接/动作三层建模表初版，以及 90 天落地路线图。
defaultInitPrompt.en: We are an industrial equipment manufacturer with 3 factories and want a business ontology to connect sales, delivery and after-sales data for real-time management visibility. Please directly provide: anchor scenario recommendations, a first draft of Object/Link/Action modeling tables, and a 90-day adoption roadmap.

quickPrompts.en: We are an industrial equipment manufacturer with 3 factories and want a business ontology to connect sales, delivery and after-sales data for real-time management visibility. Please directly provide: anchor scenario recommendations, a first draft of Object/Link/Action modeling tables, and a 90-day adoption roadmap.
quickPrompts.zh: 我们是一家有 3 座工厂的工业设备制造商，想用一套业务本体打通销售、交付与售后数据，让管理层实时掌握交付与质量状况。请直接给出：锚定场景建议、对象/链接/动作三层建模表初版，以及 90 天落地路线图。

quickPrompts.en: Demonstrate the Object Types / Link Types / Action Types framework using an after-sales service scenario: give me the three modeling tables filled with example rows that my team can directly reuse as templates.
quickPrompts.zh: 请以售后维修场景为例演示对象类型/链接类型/动作类型框架，输出三张已填好示例行的建模表，让我的团队可以直接套用作模板。

quickPrompts.en: Our ontology has been live for 3 months but business team monthly active usage is below 10%. Please diagnose the likely root causes and give a 90-day adoption recovery plan inspired by Palantir's rollout playbook.
quickPrompts.zh: 我们的本体上线 3 个月，业务团队月活不足 10%。请诊断可能的原因，并给出一个借鉴 Palantir 推行策略的 90 天采纳率拯救计划。
